caption: Supplementary Fig. 13 | Spatial moisture and geopotential contrasts around paired departures. a–c,e–g, Temporary-minus-decay q700 anomaly contrasts in Northern and Southern Hemisphere pairs. i–k,m–o, Corresponding z200 contrasts. Columns sample −24 h at the fixed departure-time t0 centre, then actual positions at 0 and +24 h. Pre-event mean shear fixes the orientation. Colours give g kg⁻¹ or m, with one scale per variable across hemispheres and times. Cell-specific paired SID counts are 74–77 in a,b, 68–71 in c, 26 in e,f, 24 in g, 77 in i,j, 71 in k, 26 in m,n and 24 in o. Eligibility does not require later track survival. d,h,l,p, Pre-event raw-common versus anomaly-common contrasts at all 709 cells for northern q700, southern q700, northern z200 and southern z200. Both coordinates share pair-and-lag support and native units; dashed lines mark equality. These descriptive comparisons retain dependence among spatial cells. Maps extend to 1,500 km and use the Methods climatology, rotation and paired cohort, with the stated mixed centre policy. A centred 199,999-draw paired-SID bootstrap supplies P and BH q values for all 5,672 hypotheses per scalar; no cell has q<0.05 (Table S5d). Source tables give cell counts, original pointwise intervals and P/q. Scatter panels introduce no additional tests.
